# dsh-herdr — one profile layer.
#
# Bundle patches *insert* rows; they do not target an existing entry id. The
# loader imports `name` as a module from the profile's node_modules and calls
# its exported apply(ctx, config).
- insert:
    - id: tool-herdr
      name: dsh-herdr

readme.text:
[](https://github.com/ahqrt/dsh-herdr/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[](LICENSE)
[](package.json)

**Delegate a subtask from DeepSeek Harness to a real coding agent in a Herdr pane — pick the model, keep the terminal, harvest the exact answer, review it in DSH.**

`dsh-herdr` is the reference bridge between [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) and [Herdr](https://herdr.dev). It turns Herdr into an external subagent runtime: DSH stays the orchestrator and reviewer, while pi / agy / claude / codex / … do the work in visible, steerable panes.

> Status: `0.11.x`, validated on DSH `0.2.1-rc.2` (all nine tools activate in a headless profile) and Herdr `0.9.4` (server `0.9.1`); admitted on DSH `0.2.1-rc.3` by the host compatibility preflight. The public surface is the nine `herdr_*` tools; breaking changes follow semver and are listed in [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md).

---

`dsh-herdr` gives the DSH agent a small vocabulary: delegate, fetch, message, list, interrupt, close, plus an inbox and a transcript pager.

---

| | |
|---|---|
| **Model routing** | Short aliases from `~/.pi/agent/model-aliases.md` (`grok4.7[high]`, `flash`, …) resolve to `provider/model` + thinking. Billing boundaries stay where you put them. |
| **Exact results** | pi children are read from their session JSONL — the last assistant message, byte-identical. `result.md` is the second source; pane tail is only the fallback. |
| **Review evidence** | A git baseline at spawn, a patch at harvest, changed files, test line, token usage, session path. |
| **Idempotency** | `client_task_id` makes a retried tool call return the existing task instead of spawning a twin. |
| **Ownership** | The plugin only closes/steers panes it created. User panes are read-only. |
| **Blocked ≠ approved** | A blocked child is surfaced to the user, never auto-answered. |
| **Cancellation** | Turn-level interrupt (Escape) without destroying the pane or session. |
| **Inbox** | Children can report `BLOCKED` / `REVIEW_REQUEST` / `COMPLETE`; `herdr_inbox` consumes them, with a long-poll. |
| **Queue** | Over the cap, a spawn waits for a slot (`queueTimeoutMs`) instead of failing. |
| **Isolation** | `isolated: true` runs the task in a fresh git worktree a

```mermaid flowchart LR DSH["DSH agent"] -->|tool call| T["herdr_* tools"] T --> S["services
spawn · harvest · message · lifecycle · doctor"] S --> P["ports
HerdrTransport · TaskStore · GitService"] The dependency rule is one-way: `tools → services → ports ← adapters`. The domain (`prompts`, `session` parsing, `aliases`, lifecycle rules) imports nothing from DSH and nothing from the OS except `node:fs`/`node:path`. See [docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md). ---

The `desktop` profile is owned by the Electron app; `dsh plugin --profile desktop …` is rejected by design.

1. Open **Plugins → Add plugin** in the app.
2. Enter the npm package name:

```text
   dsh-herdr@0.11.1
   ```

For a local checkout, enter its absolute **directory** (run `pnpm build` first):
   `/Users/apple/Desktop/deepseekharness-herdr`. A GitHub URL also works because
   `lib/` is committed.
3. Install. The plugin manager adds the dependency and the `dsh.profile.bundles` entry.
4. Start a new session; `herdr_*` tools should be listed. If the Herdr panel or
   tools do not appear, restart the app to clear the module graph.

A local `.tgz` path is not a directory spec; use the npm name, or a `.tgz` URL if
the dialog offers one.

`dsh-herdr@0.11.1` is [live on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-herdr). Tagged releases publish through the release workflow once the repository trusted publisher is configured (see [CONTRIBUTING](CONTRIBUTING.md#releases)).
```bash

dsh --profile herdr-dev --from-default-profile web --dump-config
dsh plugin --profile herdr-dev add file:$PWD
dsh --profile herdr-dev --port 0 --no-open

dsh plugin --profile herdr-dev add dsh-herdr
```

Full instructions, the skill install, and the local-development loop: [docs/installation.md](docs/installation.md).

---

```text
You:  Use grok4.7[high] to review the current diff. Read-only, findings by severity.
DSH:  → herdr_spawn_agent({ kind: "pi", model: "grok4.7", thinking: "high",
                            role: "reviewer", cwd: "/repo", prompt: "Review ..." })
      ← status=completed · 3 files · session path · final message

Fix round:

```text
You:  Send the findings back to the worker and make it fix the two majors.
DSH:  → herdr_message_agent({ target: "worker-flash-a1b2", kind: "REVIEW_FINDINGS",
                              round: 1, message: "[MAJOR] ..." })
      → herdr_get_agent_result({ target: "worker-flash-a1b2", wait: true })

More: [examples/review-a-diff.md](examples/review-a-diff.md), [examples/implement-and-review.md](examples/implement-and-review.md).

---

| Tool | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `herdr_spawn_agent` | Delegate one subtask; `role=reviewer` is read-only; `isolated:true` uses a worktree. |
| `herdr_get_agent_result` | Harvest a result; `wait:true` blocks until settled. |
| `herdr_message_agent` | Follow-ups, review findings, answers to blocked agents. |
| `herdr_list_agents` | Fleet view: owned and foreign agents. |
| `herdr_interrupt_agent` | Cancel the current turn, keep the pane. |
| `herdr_inbox` | Read child messages; `wait:true` long-polls. |
| `herdr_read_agent` | Page a pi transcript turn by turn. |
| `herdr_close_agent` | Close an owned pane; session file survives. |
| `herdr_doctor` | Environment self-check. |

The full parameter and result reference is in [docs/tools.md](docs/tools.md); the result JSON contract is [docs/result-contract.md](docs/result-contract.md).

---

The plugin also registers a DSH subagent provider named `herdr`. Point a
`dsh-tool-subagent` row at it to get native subagent cards, catalog entries, and
cancellation:

```yaml
- id: tool-subagent-herdr
  name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent"
  config:
    provider: herdr

The native tool returns the child's final text. Use `herdr_spawn_agent` when you
need the full review packet (diff, session path, artifacts, blocked question).

The plugin contributes a `Herdr` tab to the right sidebar (also reachable from
the sidebar guide). It lists the live fleet and, for an owned task, shows the
run flow, the final message, `result.md`, and the diff split into per-file
sections. The `flow` tab reads the same pi session the transcript tool pages:
turns in order, each assistant message with the tool calls it made (name +
argument preview such as the bash command), and each tool result with its
error flag and duration. It opens on the newest turns, loads older ones on
demand, and keeps following a running child; a task that failed before its
agent started shows the recorded error instead of a silent empty pane. Agents
this plugin did not spawn show a read-only pane tail instead. Owned tasks can be
interrupted or closed from the detail header or in bulk; both actions reuse the
lifecycle service's ownership gates, and close asks for confirmation. Diff hunks
are highlighted, and the patch or a single file can be copied. The header can
copy a Markdown review packet in PR, issue, or summary form, copy the task cwd,
open it in a configured editor, or reveal it in the OS file manager; the fleet
can be searched by name, cwd, kind

It reads four same-origin endpoints under `/herdr/api` (`health`, `fleet`,
`task`, `transcript`); no extra config.

1. **pi session JSONL** — `agent_session.value` from Herdr points at the file; the last assistant message wins. A message older than the prompt is ignored (freshness check).
2. **`result.md`** — every child is asked to write `status / summary / tests / files` frontmatter plus a body.
3. **Pane tail** — `agent read --source recent-unwrapped`, the honest fallback for agy and other kinds with no session file.

Git evidence is collected independently of the child: `baseline HEAD` at spawn, `git diff <baseline>` at harvest, bounded and saved to `~/.dsh/herdr/tasks/<taskId>/diff.patch`.

---

- Child agents run with **your** permissions; `allowCwd` is the hard boundary.
- The plugin can only mutate panes in its own registry (`owned: true`).
- `blocked` always goes back to a human; the plugin never approves.
- `enabled: false` is a spawn kill switch (it does not kill running agents).
- Child output is treated as **untrusted data**: DSH reviews it, it does not execute its instructions.
- Every spawn / message / close is appended to `~/.dsh/herdr/audit.ndjson`.

Details and threat model: [docs/security.md](docs/security.md).

---

| Component | Tested | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| DSH | `0.2.1-rc.2` (validated), `0.2.1-rc.3` (preflight) | desktop runtime; tool + workingDirectory APIs |
| Herdr | `0.9.4` client / `0.9.1` server | hard floor `>= 0.9.0` |
| Node | 22, 24 | ESM, no native deps |
| Kinds | `pi` (full), `agy` (launch-only), others via `agent_args` | model/thinking flags are pi-only by design |

See [docs/compatibility.md](docs/compatibility.md) for the support policy.

**从 DeepSeek Harness 把子任务派给 Herdr pane 里真实的 coding agent：指定模型、保留终端、拿回逐字结果、在 DSH 里 review。**

`dsh-herdr` 是 DeepSeek Harness 与 [Herdr](https://herdr.dev) 之间的参考桥接。它把 Herdr 当成外部子代理运行时：DSH 负责编排和验收，pi / agy / claude / codex 在你看得见、能接管的 pane 里干活。

> 状态：`0.11.x`，已在 DSH `0.2.1-rc.2` 上验证（headless profile 中 9 个工具全部激活），实测 Herdr `0.9.4`（server `0.9.1`）；DSH `0.2.1-rc.3` 已通过宿主兼容性预检。公共接口就是 9 个 `herdr_*` 工具；破坏性变更遵循 semver，并记录在 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)。

---

DSH 自带 subagent 跑在进程内，和主会话共用模型。有些场景你要的是反面：

- 用**另一个模型家族**做独立 review（grok × gpt × claude）；
- 一个**真实终端**，能看、能输入、能随时接管；
- 复用你手工开发时已经开着的 Herdr + pi pane；
- 一个**可验证**的结果，而不是一句“我做完了”：逐字最终答复 + git diff。

`dsh-herdr` 给 DSH agent 六个动作：派活、取结果、发消息、看舰队、中断、关闭。

---

| | |
|---|---|
| **模型路由** | 直接读 `~/.pi/agent/model-aliases.md`，`grok4.7[high]`、`flash` 解析成 `provider/model` + thinking。计费边界留在你写的地方。 |
| **精确结果** | pi 子 agent 从 session JSONL 读最后一条 assistant 消息，逐字；`result.md` 是第二来源；pane 尾部只做兜底。 |
| **Review 证据** | spawn 时记 git baseline，harvest 时生成 patch、改动文件、测试行、token 用量、session 路径。 |
| **幂等** | `client_task_id` 让重试的工具调用返回已有任务，不会起第二个 pane。 |
| **归属** | 插件只关闭/操作自己创建的 pane；用户自己开的 pane 只读。 |
| **Blocked 不代答** | 子 agent 等审批时交给用户，插件绝不自动批准。 |
| **可取消** | 发 Escape 中断当前 turn，pane 和 session 都保留。 |
| **Inbox** | 子 agent 可以回报 `BLOCKED` / `REVIEW_REQUEST` / `COMPLETE`，`herdr_inbox` 消费，支持长轮询。 |
| **队列** | 超过并发上限时等待空位（`queueTimeoutMs`），不是立刻失败。 |
| **隔离** | `isolated: true` 在独立 git worktree 里跑，返回路径。 |
| **Transcript** | `herdr_read_agent` 按 turn 翻 pi session，不只看最终答复。 |
| **运行流程** | 面板的 `flow` 标签页把同一份 session 逐 turn 展开：prompt、assistant 文本、每次工具调用及其参数预览、每条工具结果的错误标记与耗时；子 agent 还在跑时会自动跟随。 |
| **事件等待** | 可选 socket 传输，用 `agent.wait` 在服务端等；连接失败自动退回 CLI。 |
| **远程机器** | spawn/list/result/message 支持 `machine`，走 `herdr --machine`；SSH 文件桥（`machineTargets`）不再需要本地挂载。 |
| **原生 subagent** | 注册 `herdr` subagent provider，让 `dsh-tool-subagent` 的委派走 Herdr，获得原生卡片、catalog 和取消。 |
| **We

```mermaid flowchart LR DSH["DSH agent"] -->|tool call| T["herdr_* tools"] T --> S["services
spawn · harvest · message · lifecycle · doctor"] S --> P["ports
HerdrTransport · TaskStore · GitService"] 依赖只有一个方向：`tools → services → ports ← adapters`。domain 层（任务信封、session 解析、别名、生命周期规则）不 import DSH，也不碰 OS（除了 `node:fs` / `node:path`）。细节见 [docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md)。 ---

`desktop` profile 由 Electron 独占，`dsh plugin --profile desktop …` 会被拒绝。

1. 打开应用内 **Plugins → Add plugin**。
2. 直接填 npm 包名：

```text
   dsh-herdr@0.11.1
   ```

本地开发可以填绝对**目录**（先 `pnpm build`）：
   `/Users/apple/Desktop/deepseekharness-herdr`。GitHub 地址也可以，因为 `lib/` 已提交。
3. 安装。插件管理器会自动加依赖和 `dsh.profile.bundles`。
4. 新建会话，工具列表里应出现 `herdr_*`。如果 Herdr 面板或工具没出现，重启应用清掉旧模块图。

本地 `.tgz` 路径不是目录 spec；优先用 npm 包名，或对话框支持时填 `.tgz` 直链。
`dsh-herdr@0.11.1` 已[发布到 npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-herdr)。配好仓库的 trusted publisher 后，每个 tag 由 release workflow 自动发布（见 [CONTRIBUTING](CONTRIBUTING.md#releases)）。
```bash

dsh --profile herdr-dev --from-default-profile web --dump-config
dsh plugin --profile herdr-dev add file:$PWD
dsh --profile herdr-dev --port 0 --no-open

dsh plugin --profile herdr-dev add dsh-herdr
```

完整步骤和本地开发回路：[docs/installation.md](docs/installation.md)。

---

```text
你：  用 grok4.7[high] 起个 pane review 当前 diff，只读，按严重度列 findings。
DSH:  → herdr_spawn_agent({ kind: "pi", model: "grok4.7", thinking: "high",
                            role: "reviewer", cwd: "/repo", prompt: "Review ..." })
      ← status=completed · 3 files · session path · final message

修复轮：

```text
你：  把 findings 发回 worker，让它把两个 major 修掉。
DSH:  → herdr_message_agent({ target: "worker-flash-a1b2", kind: "REVIEW_FINDINGS",
                              round: 1, message: "[MAJOR] ..." })
      → herdr_get_agent_result({ target: "worker-flash-a1b2", wait: true })

更多：[examples/review-a-diff.md](examples/review-a-diff.md)、[examples/implement-and-review.md](examples/implement-and-review.md)。

---

| 工具 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `herdr_spawn_agent` | 派一个子任务；`role=reviewer` 只读；`isolated:true` 用 worktree。 |
| `herdr_get_agent_result` | 取结果；`wait:true` 阻塞到 settled。 |
| `herdr_message_agent` | 跟进、回传 findings、回答 blocked 的 agent。 |
| `herdr_list_agents` | 舰队视图：自己的和别人的 agent。 |
| `herdr_interrupt_agent` | 中断当前 turn，保留 pane。 |
| `herdr_inbox` | 读子 agent 消息；`wait:true` 长轮询。 |
| `herdr_read_agent` | 按 turn 翻 pi transcript。 |
| `herdr_close_agent` | 关闭自己起的 pane；session 文件保留。 |
| `herdr_doctor` | 环境自检。 |

完整参数和返回值见 [docs/tools.md](docs/tools.md)，结果 JSON 契约见 [docs/result-contract.md](docs/result-contract.md)。

---

插件还会向 DSH 的 subagent 服务注册一个名为 `herdr` 的 provider。把
`dsh-tool-subagent` 的一行指向它，就能拿到原生 subagent 卡片、catalog 和取消：

```yaml
- id: tool-subagent-herdr
  name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent"
  config:
    provider: herdr

这个原生工具只返回子 agent 的最终文本；需要 diff、session、artifact 和
blocked 问题时用 `herdr_spawn_agent`。

插件会在右侧栏贡献一个 `Herdr` 标签页（也可以从侧栏 guide 打开）。它列出实时
agent；自己派出的任务显示运行流程、最终消息、`result.md` 和按文件分组的 diff，外部 agent 只显示只读的
pane 输出。`flow` 标签页读的就是 `herdr_read_agent` 翻的那份 pi session：按顺序列出
turn，每条 assistant 消息带上它发起的工具调用（名称 + 参数预览，比如 bash 命令），
每条工具结果带错误标记和耗时；默认打开最新几页、按需往前翻，子 agent 还在跑时持续跟随；
如果任务在 agent 启动前就失败了，这里会显示记录下来的错误，而不是一片空白。自有任务可以单个或批量 interrupt/close，动作复用 lifecycle 的 ownership gate，
close 会先确认；diff 支持 hunk 高亮、整包复制和单文件复制。详情头部还能复制完整的
Markdown review packet（PR / issue / summary 三种模板）、任务 cwd，或直接在系统文件管理器中
reveal cwd 或用配置的编辑器打开；舰队搜索覆盖 name、cwd、kind、model 和 task id，
可按 machine + status 分组，并支持 ArrowUp/ArrowDown/Enter 键盘导航；packet 复制保留 3 条历史。
数据来自 `/herdr/api` 下的四个同源只读接口（`health`、`fleet`、`task`、`transcript`），不需要额外配置。

1. **pi session JSONL**：Herdr 的 `agent_session.value` 给出文件路径，取最后一条 assistant 消息。早于本次 prompt 的消息会被忽略（freshness 检查）。
2. **`result.md`**：每个子 agent 都被要求写 `status / summary / tests / files` frontmatter 加正文。
3. **pane 尾部**：`agent read --source recent-unwrapped`，给 agy 这类没有 session 文件的 kind 兜底。

Git 证据独立于子 agent：spawn 时记 `baseline HEAD`，harvest 时 `git diff <baseline>`，截断后存到 `~/.dsh/herdr/tasks/<taskId>/diff.patch`。

---

- 子 agent 用**你的**权限运行；`allowCwd` 是硬边界。
- 插件只能操作自己注册表里的 pane（`owned: true`）。
- `blocked` 永远交给人；插件不自动批准。
- `enabled: false` 是 spawn kill switch（不会杀已在跑的 agent）。
- 子 agent 的输出是**不可信数据**：DSH 把它当证据，不执行里面的指令。
- 每次 spawn / message / close 都追加到 `~/.dsh/herdr/audit.ndjson`。

威胁模型见 [docs/security.md](docs/security.md)。

| Herdr | `0.9.4` client / `0.9.1` server | 硬下限 `>= 0.9.0` |
| Node | 22、24 | ESM，无原生依赖 |
| Kinds | `pi`（完整）、`agy`（仅启动）、其它走 `agent_args` | model/thinking 只对 pi 开放，这是设计 |
